description: This PHP source file defines the class OX_OperationInterval, which provides static methods for managing and calculating operation intervals, including validation, conversion between dates and interval IDs, and interval boundary checks within the context of a weekly schedule.

classes.name: OX_OperationInterval
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling operation intervals, including validation, conversion, boundary checks, and interval calculations based on dates.

methods.name: checkOperationIntervalValue
methods.description: Validates if an operation interval value in minutes is within acceptable bounds (1-60) and is a factor of 60 if less than 60.

methods.name: convertDateRangeToOperationIntervalID
methods.description: Converts a date range into an operation interval ID if both dates are within the same week and interval.

methods.name: convertDateToOperationIntervalID
methods.description: Converts a single date into an operation interval ID based on the week and interval length.

methods.name: addOperationIntervalTimeSpan
methods.description: Returns a new date object representing the start of the next operation interval after the given date.

methods.name: convertDateToOperationIntervalStartAndEndDates
methods.description: Returns the start and end dates of the operation interval that contains the given date.

methods.name: convertDateToPreviousOperationIntervalStartAndEndDates
methods.description: Returns the start and end dates of the previous operation interval relative to the given date.

methods.name: convertDateToNextOperationIntervalStartAndEndDates
methods.description: Returns the start and end dates of the next operation interval after the given date.

methods.name: previousOperationIntervalID
methods.description: Calculates the previous operation interval ID, wrapping around the week if necessary.

methods.name: nextOperationIntervalID
methods.description: Calculates the next operation interval ID, wrapping around the week if necessary.

methods.name: checkDateIsStartDate
methods.description: Checks if a given date is the start date of an operation interval.

methods.name: checkDateIsEndDate
methods.description: Checks if a given date is the end date of an operation interval.

methods.name: checkDatesInSameHour
methods.description: Verifies if two dates are within the same hour.

methods.name: checkIntervalDates
methods.description: Validates if start and end dates correspond to a proper operation interval boundary based on the interval length.

methods.name: getOperationInterval
methods.description: Retrieves the operation interval value in minutes from global configuration.

methods.name: secondsPerOperationInterval
methods.description: Returns the number of seconds in one operation interval.

methods.name: operationIntervalsPerDay
methods.description: Calculates the number of operation intervals in a day.

methods.name: operationIntervalsPerWeek
methods.description: Calculates the number of operation intervals in a week.

methods.name: getIntervalsRemaining
methods.description: Calculates the number of operation intervals remaining between two dates.
